variants.headline: {{largest}} outgrows {{capital}}
body: The seat of government stays in {{capital}}. By the latest count, though, more people live in {{largest}} than in any other city in the country.

variants.headline: {{largest}} share the lead in population
body: {{capital}} still holds the seat of government. The latest count puts {{largest}} level with one another and ahead of the capital in population.

variants.headline: Military strength now favors {{neighbor}}
body: Our forces ranked no lower than those of {{neighbor}} in the earlier figures. The latest reckoning gives our neighbors the edge.

variants.headline: Lead in discovery goes to {{civilization}}
body: The last tally had {{civilization}} trailing in the race for new knowledge. A count of {{count}} technologies now puts the nation alone at the head of the field we can survey.

variants.headline: Discovery lead now shared by {{civilization}}
body: The race for new knowledge has grown tighter. A tally of {{count}} technologies puts {{civilization}} level at the top among the nations whose advances we can count.

variants.headline: Our nation takes the lead in discovery
body: We were behind at the last tally. Our count now stands at {{count}} technologies, ahead of every other nation in the reckoning.

variants.headline: We draw level at the head of discovery
body: Our tally of {{count}} technologies puts us alongside the foremost nations we can compare. At the last count, there was still ground to make up.

variants.headline: A Golden Age, yet little cheer at home
body: Is a Golden Age worthy of the name while our people are this unhappy and the fighting against {{enemies}} goes on? The government has little cause for celebration.

variants.headline: A Golden Age at home, with war still on
body: The country marks a Golden Age while the war against {{enemies}} continues.

variants.headline: A Golden Age gives a country at war cause for cheer
body: The Golden Age comes as a country in good spirits carries on the war against {{enemies}}. The government deserves credit for keeping spirits high in wartime.
